---
title: "Turnout"
description: "How many people vote at Dáil and European Parliament elections, compared with the EU."
---

Turnout at Dáil elections has fallen since the 1980s. At the 2024 general election, 59.7% of people on the electoral register voted, compared with 76.9% in 1969, the highest since 1948. Turnout at European Parliament elections is usually lower, at 50.1% in 2024.

{{< chart elections-turnout >}}

## Compared with the EU

Comparing each country's most recent national election, Ireland's turnout was the 7th lowest in the EU. Voting is compulsory in Belgium, Greece and Luxembourg.

{{< chart elections-turnout-eu >}}
